title: Holon
shortDescription: Your self-hosted Holon agents, conversations, work items and files on Android.
fullDescription:
Holon is the native Android client for self-hosted Holon agents. Connect to your own Holon host or one you are authorized to use, sign in, and continue working with your agents from your phone.

Browse agents and recent conversations, send prompts and selected attachments, and read result briefs. Follow work items, plans, checklists and active tasks. Browse your agent's accessible workspaces, preview files and save artifacts to your device.

Revisit cached conversations when you are offline. Messages queued while disconnected can be sent when your connection returns. Share text, links, images and files from other Android apps, then preview the content and choose which agent should receive it.

The interface supports English and Simplified Chinese, with light and dark themes. Agent messages and files remain in their original language. Holon Android has no ads.

A reachable Holon host and authorized access are required. This app does not include a hosted runtime or an AI service subscription. Your host operator chooses AI models, integrations and server-side data retention; clearing app storage does not delete records on your host or its providers.
